$comment: Entry schema for contributes.uriHandlers (process plugins only, manifest apiVersion 2). Host validation lives in backend/plugin/contrib_uri_handlers.go and uri_handler_resolve.go. Links have the form mincode://<pluginId><path>?<query>; a plugin whose id is a reserved host ({{lists.reservedHosts}}) cannot handle links. path is '/' followed by 1-{{limits.pathSegmentsMax}} segments (<= {{limits.pathMaxLength}} characters), each a literal ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}$ or a {name} parameter ^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]{0,31}$; two handlers of one plugin must not share a path shape, and a literal segment beats a parameter. A view target (one of this plugin's views) may declare query, a schema in the command inputSchema dialect (type object, string/integer/number/boolean properties with enum/default/description, required, string maxLength <= {{limits.queryValueMaxRunes}}; additionalProperties is always false; <= {{limits.queryPropertiesMax}} properties). A command target must be one of this plugin's action commands with effective risk 'read'; its link parameters are validated against the command's own inputSchema (none allowed without one), so it must not declare query or path parameters. Every link is shown in a host confirmation naming the plugin before anything opens; resolving a link never starts the plugin.
description: Plugin link handlers: open this plugin's views or read commands from mincode://<pluginId>/... links after the user confirms.

title.description: Shown in the link confirmation as plugin-provided text.

view.description: view targets: one of this plugin's contributes.views ids.

command.description: command targets: one of this plugin's action commands with effective risk 'read'.

query.description: view targets only: the accepted link query parameters.
